info.title: RailTrack Live API
info.description: Track Indian Railways trains through licensed third-party providers. All instants are UTC ISO-8601; journey dates are IST calendar dates. Responses always carry the data provider, freshness and whether positions are reported or estimated. Demo-mode responses have provider.isDemo = true.

post.description: Validates and de-duplicates train numbers, then fetches each train with provider-safe concurrency. Per-train failures are reported in results[].error.
